methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.

bottom_performers.text:
Boyd wins his 4th STRAIGHT start. 6 innings, 1 run Saturday.

In a season where the Cubs have burned through arms left and right, he's quietly become the rotation anchor.

Respect it. 💪

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

Bregman snapped an 0-for-12 slump with FOUR hits Monday — HR, two doubles, 3 runs scored.

Hoerner went 4-for-4 with a 9th-inning two-run shot. Peterson: 5⅔ innings, two runs. Fourteen hits as a team.

Cardinals are 3-8 since the break. Cubs are hunting.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

1 hit out of the NL — and PCA had it.

AL shut out the NL 4-0. Crow-Armstrong entered in the 6th, singled in the 8th, and was stranded. Three hits for the entire National League.

On to the second half. Wrigley. Twins. Friday.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB
